description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Fail MCP Prompt Discovery Loudly on OMS Errors
userStories.description: As an MCP client, I want prompts/list to fail when OMS discovery fails so that action prompt catalogues are never silently incomplete.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an MCP server with an OMS repository whose ontology listing fails
acceptanceCriteria.then: the JSON-RPC response is an internal error that includes the list failure reason

acceptanceCriteria.given: an MCP server with multiple ontologies and one action-type listing failure
acceptanceCriteria.then: the JSON-RPC response is an internal error rather than a partial prompts array

acceptanceCriteria.given: an MCP server with healthy OMS metadata
acceptanceCriteria.then: the existing prompt catalogue shape and deterministic ordering are preserved

userStories.title: Reject Fractional MCP Integer Arguments
userStories.description: As an MCP tool caller, I want integer schema fields to reject fractional JSON numbers so page sizes and similar controls are not silently truncated.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a tool input schema declares an integer field
acceptanceCriteria.when: a tools/call request supplies a fractional JSON number
acceptanceCriteria.then: the registry returns invalid params and the tool is not invoked

acceptanceCriteria.given: a tool input schema declares an integer field
acceptanceCriteria.when: a tools/call request supplies a whole JSON number
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request continues to validate successfully

userStories.title: Keep Heavy Go Data Suites out of Fast Unit Gates
userStories.description: As a CI maintainer, I want heavyweight Chinook/Northwind acceptance packages classified separately from fast unit packages so the Go unit gate stays inside the PR feedback budget.

acceptanceCriteria.given: scripts/ci/go-packages.sh is used for the unit/race/coverage gate
acceptanceCriteria.then: heavy data acceptance packages are excluded or explicitly opt-in through a documented mode

acceptanceCriteria.given: the heavy data suites remain valuable regression coverage
acceptanceCriteria.when: a developer runs the documented command
acceptanceCriteria.then: test/chinook and test/northwind still run intentionally

userStories.title: Export Quiver Workbench Dashboards as JSON
userStories.description: Replace the documented Quiver dashboard export absence with a browser-visible JSON export for the current editable workbench state.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a Quiver workbench has at least one series, when the operator opens the save controls, then an Export JSON control is visible and enabled.

Given the operator clicks Export JSON, when the browser download is prepared, then the payload includes ontologyApiName, dashboard name when supplied, dashboard rid when loaded, and the current series list including branch/color/labels.
Given the workbench has no series, then Export JSON is disabled so empty dashboard shells are not downloaded as misleading artifacts.
Given the existing Playwright feature for Quiver export, then it no longer asserts export absence and instead verifies the JSON export affordance is present.
verification: RED: npx vitest run src/components/quiver/__tests__/QuiverPage.test.tsx failed because quiver-export-json-button did not exist.

npx playwright test --list us444/ phase6/ phase7/ vtx-099-system-graph-render.spec.ts dogfood-verify.spec.ts dogfood-diagnose.spec.ts dogfood-empty-states.spec.ts us-456-perf-dashboard.spec.ts us-457-timeseries-tab.spec.ts us-458-hotkey-help.spec.ts zzz-login-rate-limit.spec.ts tests/feature.quiver.spec.ts

userStories.title: Add Aggregation Where Filter Affordance
userStories.description: Replace the documented Aggregation page filter absence with a minimal where-clause UI that sends the existing optional AggregationRequest.where contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an operator opens the Aggregation page, then a basic filter/where control is available in the config panel.
Given a filter is configured and Execute is clicked, then the aggregate request body includes a where clause.
Given no filter is configured, then the aggregate request omits where as it does today.
verification: RED: npx vitest run src/components/aggregation/__tests__/AggregationPage.where.bdd.test.tsx failed because filter-field-select did not exist.

userStories.title: Guard Northwind E2E Seed Replays from FK Wipe Failures
userStories.description: Repair the dogfood-reported Northwind seed wipe failure path so browser E2E fixtures remain populated after repeated scripts/e2e-setup.sh runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the E2E seed is replayed against a database with function rows referencing the ontology, then the wipe step does not fail on functions_ontology_rid_fkey.
Given scripts/e2e-setup.sh completes, then /api/v2/ontologies/northwind/objectTypes returns seeded object types.
Given the seed repair is verified, then the progress log records any required database/table-order learning for future streams.
verification: RED: go test ./internal/e2e -run TestBDD_E2ESetupVerifiesNorthwindObjectTypesAfterSeed -count=1 failed because scripts/e2e-setup.sh had no post-seed objectTypes probe.
